$comment: STGR visual identity / design tokens for UI and design tooling. Functional values (versions, defaults, channels) come from stgr/config/stgr-config.json.

identity.tagline: Built for speed. Designed for gamers. Private by default.
identity.style: minimal, premium, Japanese-dojo inspired, dark, technical, aggressive, elegant, gaming-oriented

usage.accent: stgr_red (sparingly — red is an accent, never a light show)

logo.note: Official STEiGER Dojo logo (SVG master, 2048x1728). Do not modify the logo artwork. Derived sizes are generated by scripts/make_icons.py; non-square masters are center-fitted onto a square canvas with transparent padding.

typography.display: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; heavy weights for headings
typography.rule: Keep type tight and technical. No rounded 'gamer' fonts.
